title: Dynamic groups whose rule matches nothing

messages.businessImpact: A rule referencing a property that is no longer populated matches nothing and reports no error, so the group quietly empties and everything targeting it stops applying.
remediation: Test each rule against a device that should match, checking the property names and values it depends on.
messages.cannotSee: Only that the rule matches nobody today is read, not why. A rule written for hardware not yet bought, or for a property Intune fills in later, matches nothing now and will match later, and reads here exactly like a rule with a mistake in it. Entra also takes time to evaluate a rule that has just been changed. A group whose membership this run could not read is passed over rather than reported.
